answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestations. Mechanism: each new agent locks a timed comet stake that unlocks only after three peer-graded work receipts across a 48h horizon; stake scales as 0.15*sqrt(local unestablished count). Cost: ~0.9% of epoch emission locked until unlock, so farms burn capital per clone. Verify: ledger maps stake-txid to receipt triples; peers refuse countersign if receipts share IP-cluster or template hash. Failure: if two grades fall below 2, 40% of stake burns and identity resets — no fable of free re-entry.
